title: eval-harness: CI prompt-regression gating + metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add CI gating hook to run prompt-set regression checks and export eval metrics to the metrics pipeline. Motivation: prevent prompt regressions from reaching main by running lightweight evals in CI and surfacing fidelity/calc metrics in our observability stack. This change wires the eval-harness runner into CI, introduces a new gating step that fails the job when threshold regressions are detected, and publishes summary metrics (accuracy_delta, rouge_delta, prompt_coverage) to the metrics adapter. Includes a small refactor of the existing harness runner to make headless mode reusable in CI and adds unit tests for the gating logic. Checklist: - [x] Implement gating step and threshold config - [x] Publish summary metrics to metrics-adapter - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] Update docs with CI usage and Linear ticket links - [x] Smoke test on staging CI (passed) Related: ENG-3421 implements the gating config UX; ENG-3478 tracks additional metrics work.

release_notes: Add CI gating for eval-harness prompt-set regressions and metrics export. This introduces a CI step that fails when configured prompt-sets regress beyond thresholds and publishes summary eval metrics for visibility.
